mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate over the past three months indicates a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profit margins and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1500 thousand units in the prior month, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1500.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100.0 index (2017=100) in the prior month, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises while the unemployment rate falls simultaneously, it signals a tight monetary policy combined with a strong labor market, which typically leads to equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market strength
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise while industrial production falls, it signals a shift from manufacturing weakness to consumer-driven economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST rises and INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising at least 0.5% in 3 months), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to higher discount rates, producing negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic regimes characterized by unemployment rates below 4.0%, the S&P 500 tends to experience negative returns due to overheating concerns and potential policy tightening, leading to 20-day forward underperformance.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.
